title: Attempt to close the splice-at-one halving obstruction
question: can the escaping-quartet and same-xi invariance obstruction be replaced by a derivable global condition?

verdict.conclusion: the strongest replacement is an aggregate fixed-point theorem for the exact positive horizontal residue, or a complete no-birth genealogy for all finite zeros. Both would prove RH without assuming pointwise same-xi halving, but neither closure invariance nor genealogy completeness follows from the current TTI arithmetic. Quaternary spectral branching exactly cancels quadratic halving and must not be conflated with carrier branching.

properties: R=0 if and only if RH
one-to-one horizontal halving strictly contracts every nonzero summand in the critical strip
aggregateCentralResidue.conditionalFixedPointTheorem: if the completed splice returns the same aggregate spectral residue while halving eta one-to-one, then R=R_after<R unless R=0; hence RH
aggregateCentralResidue.missingBridge: derive aggregate residue invariance from the prime-side completed ledger or seam law

branchMultiplicity.consequence: with four spectral descendants at half displacement, sum eta^2 is exactly conserved and the exact central residue is slightly increased; therefore the four-way carrier event cannot also be assumed to multiply zero quartets in a contraction proof

sufficientConditions: every finite-stage zero has a parent at the preceding stage
every child has half its parent horizontal displacement
there are no unparented births at any height
the finite completions converge locally uniformly to xi
finiteGenealogyRoute.consequence: Rouche-Hurwitz transfer then forces every xi zero onto the critical line
finiteGenealogyRoute.currentFailure: the observed bounded-window counts are nonmonotone and do not define complete parent maps

escapingDetection.consequence: the convergent central residue weights a fixed-displacement quartet at height phi^N by O(phi^(-4N)), so residue convergence alone cannot detect escape; a supremum or compactified seam norm is required

properties: equals one at z=+/-1/2, preserving Xi_N(0)=Xi_N(1)=1/2
retains the off-line quartet at z=+/-1/4+/-i phi^N
normalizedStressFamily.consequence: endpoint normalization and the two xi symmetries do not exclude escape

canonicalKernelRoute.observation: the polynomial stress factor is not shown to remain inside the positive theta-carrier class, so canonical admissibility can exclude this particular perturbation
canonicalKernelRoute.limitation: positivity, evenness and log-concavity of a Fourier kernel do not by themselves imply that its transform has only real zeros
canonicalKernelRoute.sufficientTarget: construct kernels K_N whose Fourier transforms are real-rooted and which converge to the exact Riemann kernel strongly enough to give local uniform convergence of the transforms
canonicalKernelRoute.literatureContext: Pólya-like real-rooted approximations exist, but matching the body of the exact Riemann kernel while preserving real-rootedness remains the unresolved step
canonicalKernelRoute.dyadicRequirement: each splice-at-one refinement must preserve the Laguerre-Polya or total-positivity property; positive carrier addition alone is insufficient without an interlacing theorem

progress: pointwise same-xi invariance can be weakened to aggregate positive-residue fixed-point invariance
the exact contraction ratio is derived and is close to one quarter in the critical strip
a complete no-birth genealogy gives the required global strip directly
normalizing the escaping factor at s=0 and s=1 does not remove it
quaternary spectral multiplication is incompatible with a quadratic contraction argument
remainingObligations: derive aggregate residue invariance from TTI rather than postulate it
or prove complete zero genealogy with no births at arbitrary height
or prove a convergent sequence of real-rooted canonical kernel approximations
construct a compactified seam norm that remains coercive at infinite height
logicalAssessment.status: the obstruction is narrowed but not overcome; no proof of RH is obtained
